text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retire this historical architecture roll-up, not a claim of complete fmrireg parity. Live dependency inventory has eight closed slices and only two open P3 extensions: optional plugin catalog bd-01KX2CQZFRZHXS40YWA9PDX0DV and group/meta expansion bd-01KX2CQZGWBQ3KKX7BWE28X3T2. There are no issues depending on this epic. Current source contains FitInterpreter, ChunkProgram, ResponsePreparation, GLS/Robust/ReducedRankGls and the workflow AnalysisPlan. Its legacy result-writer slice is superseded by active estimate-set work. Keeping this broad extension-spine epic open until optional plugins and new estimators ship obscures the current core correctness/performance programme. Close the roll-up as retired-historical; preserve both open extension issues, all dependency history, and current P1 scientific-identity, GLS, calibration and performance work independently. The design principles remain useful; no numerical/whole-repository qualification or implementation of optional children is implied. This assessment makes no code changes and runs no additional architecture-wide tests.
